thread:
maria_sales: Hey team — Heartwood (devon_heartwood) pushed back on our SIG BCP answers and wants clarifications on RTO/RPO, backups, region failover, and our SLA behavior for Dedicated vs Hosted. They need a consolidated response by EOD PT. Can security + SE confirm short, customer-facing answers I can paste into the questionnaire?

olivia_se: I pulled the current draft into the shared sheet: https://redwood.internal/heartwood-bcp-draft (see tab ‘answers_v2’). Main asks: explicit RTO/RPO numbers, backup cadence + retention, cross-region failover steps, DR test cadence, and who owns runbooks.

ajay_security: Quick answers we can provide — keep them high-level. I’ll flag anything that requires an exception.

ajay_security: RTO/RPO (hosted API): RTO for control-plane & control-plane-triggered recovery actions: <= 15 minutes for global control-plane failover scenarios. Data RPO: near-zero for customer request/objects (writes are synchronously replicated across AZs in-region). For model state / transient KV caches RPO is best-effort; critical persisted artifacts are replicated to durable storage.

ajay_security: RTO/RPO (Dedicated): RTO is dependent on customer allocation and chosen failover policy — default Dedicated footprint provides multi-AZ within-region redundancy with RTO target of <= 1 hour for node replacement and pod rescheduling. Cross-region DR (optional): RTO depends on warm-standby config; we document runbook and estimate in the SOW.

ajay_security: Backups & retention: nightly snapshots of customer config + metadata retained for 30 days by default; longer retention available as an add-on. Backups are encrypted at rest with customer-managed keys (optional KMS/HSM integration). Object and model artifacts are stored in durable blob storage with lifecycle policies.

ajay_security: Failover model: automatic in-region AZ failover for hosted tiers (stateless runtime + KV cache rebuild). For Dedicated we offer configurable failover: - active-active across AZs (default) - active-passive cross-region (optional, requires customer enable). For cross-region, we use controlled promotion with traffic cutover and validation steps in the runbook.

ajay_security: SLAs and uptime: Hosted API default SLA is 99.9% monthly uptime for paid tiers (see SLA doc). Dedicated SLA can be increased in contract (99.95% or higher) depending on reserved capacity and HA options. SLA credits are defined in the Master Services Agreement.

ajay_security: DR testing & exercises: We run tabletop exercises annually and simulated failovers quarterly for hosted infra. Customers on Dedicated can opt into joint DR drills (we recommend semi-annual). We provide after-action notes and are happy to run a joint runbook walkthrough during POC.

ajay_security: Point about data residency / restore windows: Full restore time depends on dataset size and network egress; typical customer config restores (small configs + <200GB model blobs) complete within 1–3 hours in our experience. Larger datasets will be scoped in the SOW.

olivia_se: For the questionnaire, keep each answer 1–2 short paragraphs and link to the SLA + security whitepaper. I’ll format for SIG/CAIQ fields (they want succinct bullets).

pat_legal: Note — any commitment above standard SLA or cross-region active-passive DR must be reflected in the contract addendum. If Heartwood asks for a guaranteed RTO of <30m for Dedicated cross-region, we need legal + infra sign-off.

devon_heartwood: Thanks — that helps. Can you confirm backup encryption is with customer-managed KMS for Dedicated? Also need confirmation we can get DR runbook prior to purchase.

ajay_security: Yes for Dedicated: we can integrate customer KMS (AES-256 envelope with CMK) — will be in the technical onboarding checklist. Runbook: we’ll provide a redacted DR runbook for review (ops playbook with steps, not internal secrets) prior to procurement.

maria_sales: Perfect. Olivia — can you convert these into the SIG BCP response bullets? I’ll include pat_legal for any contract-facing ask. I’ll send the completed SIG back to Heartwood by 5pm PT.

olivia_se: On it. Draft will be in the sheet and I’ll ping you for a final sign-off before I reply.

deploy-bot: scheduled:dr-sim reminder — Quarterly DR simulation (hosted) runs in 3 days.

maria_sales: Thanks everyone — will loop devon_heartwood once we have the tidy answers. :thumbsup:
